title: Playback as a real instrument
acceptance: The voice is the clock under every reader control: a seek re-anchors the voice at the start of a passage and the words follow it there; replay is a seek to the passage on screen; the pace is the voice's rate, the Player's timers following for what no voice says. No second clock.

The runtime offers position(), passages(), seek({ segmentId } | { delta }), replay() and setPace(rate in 0.5 to 2), each journaled (seek, replay, pace, voice.recovered); the snapshot carries pace and position. A seek while held lands on the passage's first words, shown, with nothing said; a seek from the end plays again.

The voices (browser, synthetic) seek and set their rate; the speech governor forgets passages said again and rescales to a new pace; a seek lifts a stand-down; the conductor lands the running scene's earlier cues at once (instant), which reaches a generated scene's worker.

In the card, the full transport: back, Play/Pause, forward, replay, pace (0.8x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x), full screen where the host or browser offers it, Settings, and a beat line of one tick per passage that seeks and shows progress; Passage N of M in the hidden status; keys on the stage (Space, arrows, R, F, minus/equals, brackets) described to assistive technology; fits 320 px in one row. transport 'minimal' keeps the two objects of the 2026-10-05 decision for ChatGPT.
Full screen asks a host card through ui/request-display-mode for a mode its host offers, the app declaring inline, fullscreen and pip at hello; the Worker's ChatGPT metadata stays inline only.

evidence.note: Branch playback-instrument: 16 tests on the field's 17-beat Current with the synthetic voice (forward and back seeks, instant cues, seek from the end, seek while held, ten seeded seeks with no voice.degraded, recovery after a stand-down, replay, pace 2 and 0.5, holds following the pace, passages()).

Seek sweep: 3 voices x 8 points, one to three passages on or back, through the first 12 s; 0 stand-downs; every run ends with the voice 4063 ms before the words (the closing shown line), as the pause sweep does.

Every transport control and key, disabled states, the live region's Passage N of M, the pace cycle, both transports, full screen under an inline-only host, a host offering full screen, one offering pip, and no host card with and without the browser's full screen.

Local Chromium, one worker, whole file: 45 passed. New: forward and back in the self-contained card show the passage's first words and the voice begins it there; replay; pace 1.5 holds the shown line about 840 ms against about 1250 ms; ArrowRight on the stage; full screen absent inline-only and requested of a host that offers it; seven objects in one row at 320 px. Fake host, not a product host.
Amended 2026-10-08: the two-control rule was ChatGPT's two-action guideline; the Claude card carries the transport bar; transport 'minimal' keeps the two objects.

activity.summary: Built on branch playback-instrument: runtime seek, replay and pace with the voice moving first, and the stage bar in the card; not merged, not deployed, no host witness.

summary: Seek, replay and pace that move the voice first, and a transport bar in the Claude card; the ChatGPT edition keeps two objects.
blocker: Branch only: review, merge and a real-host witness (owner's witness pass, 2026-10-07) remain.
